summary: Iteration 4 tested Undo Delete, Best Store Trip, the Weekly Ad Browser, the Savings Share Card, plus regression of demo login, check deals now, add item and editing stores. Backend: 38/38 tests passed (test_iteration4_undo_trip_ads.py + test_promobeaux_api.py). Testing-agent extras passed 4/4 (test_iteration4_extra.py: second delete/restore 404, deals restored, on_deal rows first, Walmart/Target ads). Frontend (375x667): every requested flow works. Undo banner restores the item and auto-hides at about 6s. Ads chips, lines, Watch -> add-item prefill and back all work. Trip shows Kroger, $3.30 saved, $51.74 total, progress 0/6 -> 2/6 -> 1/6; checks persist after navigating away and after reload; clear works. Share card total $9.04 matches savings-total; share on web shows the 'Sharing isn't available here' banner (acceptable); close works. Main data-quality bug: the Walmart weekly ad contains 18 Spanish Walmart Mexico lines priced in MXN (source informador.mx), shown to a US ZIP 75201 user. No deprecated Expo packages found (no expo-av, expo-barcode-scanner or expo-background-fetch).

critical.issue: The cached ad has 18 of 36 lines from https://www.informador.mx/... (Walmart Mexico, Spanish, MXN prices, e.g. 'Arrachera marinada de Res SuKarne a $218.00 el empaque', 'Calabaza blanca a $130.00 la pieza'). These are shown to a US user (ZIP 75201). _match_store only checks that the store name appears, not that the source is US/English.

minor.issue: Empty results are cached: H-E-B|75201 and Tom Thumb|75201 have 0 lines. Because demo users always get the cached copy (even with refresh=true), they see an empty ad forever, and the ad never goes stale for demo users. Consider not caching empty results, or giving demo users a TTL such as 24h.

Article headlines and non-product promo text get through as ad lines, e.g. 'Walmart Cash Back Deals: Pasta Moneymaker, Free Dreft, $1 Pumpkin, and more!', 'Target Deals This Week: $0.49 Palmer's ...', 'Save $1 off each item WYB (5+) participating products...'.

Edge case: if the item is deleted, a real scan then clears the demo sample deals, and the item is restored, the old is_sample deals are re-inserted. Consider dropping is_sample deals on restore when the user already has real results.

Deals from stores the user has since removed are still counted. The tie-break gives stores not in user.stores a key of 0, which beats listed stores at index 1 and above. Consider filtering to user.stores.

ui_bugs.issue: guessName takes the text before the first '$', so promo lines produce bad names: 'Save $1 off each item WYB...' -> 'Save', 'Buy 2 Ortega Original Taco...' -> 'Buy 2 Ortega...'. Strip leading 'Buy N'/'Save' and skip lines whose name is shorter than 2 words.

integration_issues.issue: Shows MXN/Spanish Walmart Mexico items (backend issue above).

issues: savings-share-button tap area is 57x15px with no hitSlop. Add padding or hitSlop to reach 44px.
in-app-banner-action (Undo) is 59x28px. Add hitSlop or raise its height to 44px.

The AlertWatcher deal banner ('Cheerios is BOGO at Walmart') can appear over a stack screen's header just after login, covering the ads chips, back and close buttons for about 4.5s. Tapping where a chip is hits the banner and navigates to /deals. This is existing behaviour, but more visible now that there are more stack screens.
trip-clear-button is a small text link ('Clear checkmarks'). Consider hitSlop.

action_items: HIGH: In weekly_ad (and the deal check, if it shares the matcher), reject non-US/non-English sources: skip TLDs like .mx/.es/.ca-fr and URLs with /es/; detect Spanish markers such as ' el kilo', ' la pieza', 'ofertas'; or pass include_domains / a US hint to Exa. Then purge ad_cache 'Walmart|75201'.
Don't cache ad results with 0 lines, or give demo users a TTL (e.g. 24h) so stale or empty ads refresh.
Filter headline/promo-only lines in _ad_lines (e.g. lines containing 'Deals This Week', 'and more!', starting with 'Save $').
Improve guessName in app/ads.tsx (strip 'Buy N'/'Save $x' prefixes).
Touch targets: add hitSlop/padding to savings-share-button, in-app-banner-action and trip-clear-button.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 819 lines (>700). Consider splitting into routers (watchlist/trash, trip, ads, scheduler).
Trip checkmark storage key 'trip_checked_<store>' is not scoped per user; stale ids collect but have no visible impact.
FastAPI on_event is deprecated (use lifespan); minor.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows work; minor design issues

seed_data_creation: Demo users created via POST /api/auth/demo; one added TEST_Greek Yogurt and Aldi to its stores. No seeded data modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Wait about 7s after demo login before tapping header items on stack screens: the AlertWatcher deal banner covers the header and steals force-clicks. Ads chip testIDs are lowercase with no punctuation (ads-store-kroger, ads-store-heb, ads-store-tomthumb). ad_cache currently holds Kroger/Walmart/Target/Aldi/Sprouts/H-E-B/Tom Thumb for 75201. Run pytest with '-n 0' to see print output (pytest.ini enables xdist).
rca_of_issue: MXN lines: Exa query '{store} weekly ad this week grocery sale prices near 75201' returned informador.mx 'Martes de frescura en Walmart'. _match_store(blob, [store], url) passes because 'walmart' is in the URL and title. _ad_lines accepts any line with a price regex match and 3+ letters, so 'Calabaza blanca a $130.00 la pieza' passes.
